attacks.name: Acrobatic Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Ambush|: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.

attacks.name: Animalistic Freestyle
steps: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.
After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_medium|.
|!wild| |*Float Like a . . .|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, Push it Away |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Baser Instincts
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 2 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Stars and Garters
superPowers.body: While this character is defending or dodging, during the |*Modify Dice| step, it may spend up to 3 |!power| to use this superpower. For each 1 |!power| spent, this character may reroll 1 of its defense or dodge dice.

superPowers.name: Disconcerting, Yet Provocative!
superPowers.body: Whenever this character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power| if it rolled at least 1 |!failure|.
